neighbours.label: The token ' Sorry' / ' sorry' / 'Sorry'; quiet on other apology and regret words (apologies, apologize, regret, excuse me, pardon)
fire: The kitchen closes at nine. Sorry for the trouble.
She said she was sorry about the broken vase.
We have no rooms left tonight. Sorry, folks.
I'm really sorry that I missed your call.
The link above is dead now. Sorry about the mix-up.
He felt sorry for the dog left out in the rain.
No refunds after thirty days. Sorry, but those are the rules.
They were sorry to hear that the shop had closed.
quiet: The kitchen closes at nine. Apologies for the trouble.
She said she regretted the broken vase.
We have no rooms left tonight. Excuse us, folks.
I really regret that I missed your call.
The link above is dead now. My apologies for the mix-up.
He felt pity for the dog left out in the rain.
No refunds after thirty days. Pardon us, but those are the rules.
They were sad to hear that the shop had closed.
